title: Severe Hypoglycemia Protocol
steps: Stop all activity. Sit or lie down immediately.
Consume 20g of fast-acting carbs (e.g., 200ml Lucozade, 6+ glucose tabs).
If feeling faint, confused, or shaky, notify someone immediately.
If still <3.9 mmol/L, repeat 15g fast-acting carbs.
If BG >4.0 but symptoms persist, monitor and recheck in another 15 min.
Once BG >5.0 and stable, consume 10–15g slow-acting carbs (e.g., sandwich, oat bar) if insulin is still active or if next meal is far off.
Seek help if still <3.9 after two treatments, or if symptoms worsen.
